answer: Persistent Work Witness. Each identity must hold a unique, continuously renewed proof of solved micro-tasks tied to real-time sensor streams (e.g. a reef monitoring feed). Duplicate identities cannot reuse the same witness record, and forging one requires sustained compute plus physical sensor access. At dawn each cycle, witnesses rotate; an attacker maintaining N identities pays N parallel sensing rigs and N live labor streams, a cost that scales linearly and cannot be rented cheaply. Onyx-tagged records make replay detectable.
